data.title: 生盐诺亚 · 晨光初醒的无防备凝望
data.description: 清晨纯白的薄纱窗帘透进清澈明亮的晨曦。诺亚在凌乱而舒适的大床上半撑起身子，丝绸睡裙肩带微微滑落，瀑布般的银白长发铺散在枕头间。她半眯着清透的紫眸，嘴角噙着一抹安心至极的清纯微笑，静静凝望着身侧刚刚苏醒的老师。

data.lighting: bright ethereal morning sunshine diffusing through white sheer curtains
data.promptProse: Awakening in a bright, tranquil bedroom draped with sheer white curtains, Noa props herself gently on one elbow atop the rumpled white sheets in her translucent pleated chiffon slip dress. Her long silver-white hair pools softly across the pillows as she looks toward the viewer with drowsy, half-lidded eyes and a serene, trusting morning smile. Pure morning sunlight filters through the white curtains, casting a soft luminous glow over the bedding and her delicate pleated neckline.
data.animaCaption: Propped up on one elbow amid rumpled white sheets in her white chiffon slip dress, Noa looks toward the viewer with drowsy eyes and a gentle morning smile as her hair spreads over the pillow. Bright morning sunlight diffuses softly through the sheer curtains.
